records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Works
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Real progress unaided: first_project day 0 and 1 invite sent by 8/26 (slack:2b091fd9), so the admin is active. But zero replies to three outbound emails (7356e119, 55998e5e, fc11b4f4), no tickets, and key_milestone still unreached at day 6 with 8 days left suggests slowing momentum.

draft.subject: One next step for Cedar Works
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

You've already got a project going in Wrenfield and an invite out to a teammate, which is the right order -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

If the invite didn't land, an admin can resend an invite, or remove and re-invite, a teammate who lost access to their email. And if it's easier, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's left with you.

Best,
Chidi
